instruction: tokenize() in lexer.py copes with simple expressions but breaks on edge cases: some inputs crash with exceptions other than LexError, and others come back as the wrong tokens. tests/test_lexer.py fails. Make tokenize() follow the lexical rules in lexer.py's module docstring, reporting every malformed input as a LexError that carries the documented position. Keep the Token and LexError API, change only lexer.py, and don't modify the tests.
